messages:
Marta (Design): Quick design check: added a small 'corrID' pill to the left of request rows in the trace list. Idea is to make correlation IDs more discoverable without opening the drilldown. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/corrid-pills

Marta (Design): Questions: 1) should the pill be copyable directly, or open a small menu with copy/export actions? 2) how does this affect export ordering and the export modal copy?

Ryan (Design): Love the visibility boost. Prefer pill to be copy-on-click with a tiny chevron to open actions (copy / copy+open / view related). Keeps primary action simple. Visually avoid pushing content; left-rail overlay works. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng): Copy-on-click is easy. For keyboard and SRs we need an explicit menu trigger with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Suggested DOM order: [pill-button] then [chevron-menu-button] so tab order is predictable.

Nina (A11y): Important: the pill must expose the full correlation id via aria-label (not truncated). Example: aria-label="Correlation ID: 4a7f... copy actions". If clicking copies to clipboard, add a short SR announcement: "Correlation ID copied" using aria-live polite.

Alex (Product): Export ordering question: users expect exported CSV/JSON to include corr_id as a first column/field. That means export modal should explicitly show ordering preview. Also add option: "Include correlation ID as first column" toggled on by default.

Priya (Support): Customers often paste corr IDs into incident trackers. Copy-on-click is great. But we need copy analytics (how often copied) to prioritize. Also include a small helper: "Click to copy" hover text.

Marta (Design): Copy string for tooltip/A11y? Options: "Copy correlation ID", "Show actions", "Copy corrID". Thoughts?

Nina (A11y): Use longform: "Copy correlation ID for this request" as tooltip and aria-label. Keep it descriptive for SR users.

Sam (Eng): Export JSON snippet suggestion (inline export_v2):
```json
{ "trace_id": "t-123", "corr_id": "4a7f-9c", "frames": [...] }
```
For CSV default: [corr_id, timestamp, service, message]. We'll add flag export_corr_first=true.

Ryan (Design): UI for tiny menu: chevron opens menu with three items: Copy, Show Related, Export (CSV/JSON). Keep menu reachable by keyboard and SR-friendly. Use role="menu" and focus trap rules.

Nina (A11y): Role menu is ok but make sure it's a true toolbar/menu pattern and not a generic popup. Use aria-controls to link to the export preview modal. Also ensure Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the pill.

Alex (Product): Export modal copy: Title "Export trace / requests" Checkbox default checked: "Include correlation ID as first column/field" Helper: "Correlation IDs are helpful for cross-system linking; review before sharing." Add small advanced link: "Customize export column order."

Priya (Support): Add support note: "Mask or remove correlation IDs before sharing externally if they contain internal routing information." Also include a FAQ entry on copying vs exporting.

Sam (Eng): Implementation notes: copy action will call navigator.clipboard.writeText(id) and trigger aria-live announcement. For analytics we'll ping /events with event=copy_corrid. For export ordering we'll add a param export_corr_first.

Marta (Design): Keyboard shortcut idea: when focus on a row, press 'C' to copy corrID, 'R' to open related requests. Good?

Nina (A11y): Shortcuts ok if discoverable. Add a tooltip or help line: "Shortcuts: C copy corrID, R show related" and ensure they don't conflict with browser/OS. Also ensure alternatives for users who cannot use modifiers.

Ryan (Design): Visuals: pill should be monospace, subtle background, 16px height, high-contrast focus ring. When menu is open, show a small preview of export ordering.

Alex (Product): One more: for exports initiated from the pill menu, default to exporting only related traces unless user picks full trace. We should make that explicit in copy: "Export related requests (default) — includes corr_id, timestamp, service".

Sam (Eng): I'll add API param export_scope=related|full and export_corr_first flag. Will prototype clipboard announcement and analytics in a small PR.

Marta (Design): Action items: Ryan to update comps with overlay pill + menu, Sam to prototype menu/clipboard/export flags, Nina to draft SR strings and shortcut discoverability copy, Alex to finalize export modal copy, Priya to add support blurb.

deploy-bot: integration window reminder 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — tag PRs with #corrid-pills.

Marta (Design): Thanks folks, unless objections I'll land "Copy correlation ID" tooltip copy and include_corr_first=true as default for exports. :sparkles:
